title: Remarkably Bright Creatures by Shelby Van Pelt
description:
This week’s Novels and Nibbles is a remarkable story about Tova Sullivan, a widow who cleans an aquarium while grieving the mysterious loss of her son decades earlier. Her unlikely friendship with Marcellus, a clever giant Pacific octopus, and a young man searching for answers about his family brings long-buried secrets to the surface. Warm, witty, and touching, it’s a story of finding family where you least expect it. Small book. Big feelings.

Straight from the pages of this book comes an unforeseen delight for the taste buds that sounds a little bananas because it is! Flygande Jakob (Flying Jacob), a Swedish casserole and Tova’s son’s favorite, combines shredded chicken, crispy bacon, and sliced bananas with house-made whipped cream folded with sweet chili sauce. Finished with salted peanuts and even more crispy bacon, then served over white rice, it’s an unexpected combination that had all of the Small Café staff coming back for another taste.

A little curiosity pays off deliciously, so bring your palate and join us for a culinary adventure!
